units.source_text: 回想起来，虽然这不是什么大不了的事，但日本妇女的身体由于近年来体育的进步，也起了很大的变化。

en.t: Looking back, although this was not such a great matter, the bodies of Japanese women also underwent a great change because of the progress of physical education in recent years.

units.source_text: 一个女人在受到古老历史的沉重压抑、无知者众多的埃及以身作则，把这项工作完成了。

en.t: In Egypt, weighed down by an ancient history and filled with many ignorant people, one woman set an example with her own body and completed this work.

units.source_text: 还有，特莱密夫人的话，对今天的日本男女来说都是含有许多教训的。

en.t: Moreover, Madame Trelamie's words contain many lessons for Japanese men and women today.
